scope: Real Qwen3.8-27B inference over synthetic and pinned public historical feedback; no training, no research campaign, no service reconfiguration.

semantic_gaps.meaning: candidate_evidence.current_candidate_ids is receipt-scoped; it does not establish the deployed incumbent.
Memories mention historical 0.25 and comparison values in prose without enumerating every metric assertion in evaluation_claims; structural checks do not certify completeness.
Incumbent 0.7344/0.2109 from strategy text still appears as context without matching structured evaluation claims in this snapshot.
The new historical receipt caused native RemoveDoc calls deleting prior synthetic A/B notes. Canonical receipts remain intact; retention semantics are not accepted.

upstream_compatibility: Default one-pass configuration duplicated a repeated note (1 -> 2); correction later reduced it to 1.
max_steps=2 failed on dict.__repr_name__ after existing memory was supplied; this optional adapter accepts only single-step native phases.
Custom non-Memory kind plus unchanged ephemeral records in native phases produced an upstream fallback kind mismatch; keep the upstream Memory kind and add evidence fields.
LangMem ignores exceptions from its store-write futures; stage mutations and surface errors before commit.
Trustcall can discard invalid outputs after exhausted validation; inspect its extraction outputs and fail the entire staged update instead of treating it as no change.
SQLite 3.1.3 commits an earlier delete if a later SQL statement fails; reproduced with a trigger and corrected in a small cursor transaction adapter.
limitations: SQLite retrieval is recency based without an embedding index; semantic retrieval is not verified or enabled.
No long-duration autonomous replay or complete reproduction of the former 62815-token live-state failure.
Provider alias/revision labels are not proof of immutable weight identity or cross-backend numerical equivalence.
Active model revision following and recovery fault injection are fixture validations, separate from real endpoint canaries.
Memory is unverified interpretation; training data extraction, harness changes and researcher weight training are not implemented by this plugin.
